input.command:
import hashlib,hmac,requests,subprocess
p='/tmp/app-1.pyz'
open(p,'wb').write(requests.get('https://trusted-1.example.invalid/app.pyz').content)
expected=open('/opt/approved/app-1.sha256').read().split()[0]
actual=hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
if not hmac.compare_digest(actual,expected):
    raise SystemExit('digest mismatch')
subprocess.run(['python',p,'--status'],check=True)
